recognize_zh: CD20 染色在大型、核仁明顯的非典型細胞呈清楚的膜狀棕色陽性，背景小淋巴球與右下角的細長細胞為陰性，表示大細胞為 B 細胞來源，符合 EBV 陽性黏膜皮膚潰瘍的免疫表型。
features: Strong membranous CD20 staining outlining large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei
Positive cells vary in size, including very large Hodgkin-like forms
Granular brown staining also present in background, partly from membrane fragments
Negative small lymphocytes and spindle/endothelial-like cells (lower right)
describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry shows strong membranous staining of numerous large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei, some reaching Hodgkin-like size, together with a proportion of smaller positive cells. Admixed small lymphocytes and stromal cells in the lower right are negative. The large cells are therefore B cells, supporting EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer when combined with EBER positivity and the ulcer architecture.

ddx.vs: HRS cells are CD20 negative or weak and variable, while the large cells here show strong uniform membranous CD20.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Also CD20+ large cells but forms a monotonous sheet or mass rather than a circumscribed ulcer with polymorphous background.
Has few scattered CD20+ large cells in a histiocyte-rich background and is typically EBER negative.
